articles.excerpt_html: A client participating in the Washington State Fair (here is their website) reached out to our company with a request to purchase an interactive floor, as well as to develop a unique interactive game that they could showcase at the annual Washington State Fair. First, we needed to consider the technical factors. The venue where...
articles.body_html:
A client participating in the Washington State Fair (here is their website) reached out to our company with a request to purchase an interactive floor, as well as to develop a unique interactive game that they could showcase at the annual Washington State Fair.

First, we needed to consider the technical factors. The venue where the interactive floor was to be installed presented several challenges; it was very bright, dusty, and only had a plain concrete floor that couldn’t be covered with a white cloth to enhance projection brightness. Therefore, we decided to use a 10,000-lumen projector from BenQ, which ultimately proved to be the right decision.

How The Event Went

Here is what the client had to say:

We were able to display a 16ft by10ft installation that attracted so much attention. The installation was covered with kids jumping up and down, playing this interactive farming game. We think this innovative approach to interactive technology not only works in an environment with no modification, but also amidst very significant challenges like large open windows, bright lights and a gray concrete floor. Our 10 000 lumen LU9800 projector was perfect.

“BOB WUDECK”
Senior Director of Business Development at BenQ America

Here are some photos of the system installation at the Washington State Fair. The system was set up for a month and a half before being relocated to another venue at the Holiday Magic Fair.

In this article, we’ll discuss our unique approach to custom game development.

Custom Game Development

Here is the initial description we received for the first game.

“The main themes are agriculture, cattle nutrition, types of cattle breeds, and educational fun. The game aims to convey the importance of balanced nutrition for cattle and how different feeds contribute to their health.

The vision for the interactive floor game is to create an engaging and educational experience where players act as ‘The Farmer’ to learn about creating ‘total mixed rations’ of cattle nutrition and try to collect enough feed to total the 100 lbs a day that cows need, matching the ratios of cattle feed in real life. The game is designed like Pac-Man, where The Farmer will navigate through a maze, set on the farm, to collect different types of cattle feed, such as grains, hays, silage, byproducts, and vitamins & minerals adding up to 100 pounds. Each type of feed would have a number associated with it, signifying the number of pounds they’ve collected and correspond to the percentage of each type of feed a cow will need.

The goal is to get a balanced total mixed ration without going over any of the percentages.
Participants will interact with the game by moving their farmer character around the maze. Motion sensing technology will track their movements, allowing them to “collect” different types of feed by physically moving to those locations in the maze and avoiding potential threats. Threats will be elements that affect crop production including (1) weather – (heat, storms, drought), (2) transportation and transit issues, and (3) cost of goods $ and how it affects the farmers ability to purchase additional types of feed.“

Based on this description, we applied our professional creative vision and proposed a game that seamlessly incorporated all these elements. As a result, the client was highly satisfied!

The Farmer

This game is designed to align with the following learning standards:

MSLS4.D: Biodiversity and Humans.
MSESS3.C: Human Impacts on Earth Systems
ESE Standard 3: Sustainability and Civic Responsibility

Tutorial

1 player mode

2 player mode

4 player mode

Holiday Magic Fair
Almost immediately after completing this project, the client approached us again with a request to create a game for the Holiday Magic Fair.

This game was relatively simple, but fostered a lot of joy and created a positive environment.

Are You Looking for Custom Development for an Interactive Game?

We’ll create a game personalized to your unique concept idea and venue. Contact us for a free consultation!

Odyssey Aquarium, one of the largest aquariums in the western United States, has chosen our commercial interactive sandbox for their exhibit. This unique installation has become a true centerpiece for visitors, especially children. The KIDSjumpTECH team traveled to Odyssey Aquarium to set up the sandbox, demonstrate its functionality, and gather video testimonials from the aquarium’s staff.

Our Sandbox stands out with its brightness. Once installed, we noticed the competitors’ interactive floor displays simply “dimmed” in comparison. Following the sandbox installation, we received numerous inquiries from across Arizona. We are now in touch with individuals who have tested the sandbox and are thrilled with our work. Many are already expressing interest in ordering additional exhibits, including the popular “Living Drawings“.

Unique Sensory Sand

Our sandbox features Sensory Sand, a specialized product with the following benefits:

Dust-free and safe for indoor use.
Requires no moisture, making it easy to shape and mold.
Its composition closely mimics natural sand.
Laboratory-tested, ensuring complete safety for users.

Tailored Solutions for Every Client

We offer a wide range of customization options for our sandboxes:

Variety of shapes:

Round, petal-shaped, or any other design to seamlessly fit museum or entertainment center spaces.

Custom design and branding:

Tailored aesthetics, including client-specific stickers and styling.

Custom sizes:

From standard models to unique solutions, like the sandbox in Dubai (2.5 x 1.4 meters), which accommodates a large number of children.

Custom interactive Sanbox in WePlay Dubai

Here’s what the Odyssey Aquarium team had to say about our sandbox. Watch our presentation video to learn more:

Sam Albee

Guest Relations Supervisor

The kids seem to really enjoy it. From the moment we set it up, we've had kids at it pretty much non-stop. Even for the guest experience, it’s pretty easy to explain and use.

Sophie

Guest Relations Team Member

Matt

Interactive sandboxes have become standout attractions for museums, aquariums, and children’s educational centers. They provide a unique experience that captivates guests and leaves unforgettable memories

Place: Sacramento
Date: March 10, 2024

Ruby Harris, a mother of 3 children, 28-33 years old, discovered our products back in December of 2022.
All 3 children are on the Autism spectrum, accompanied by ADHD; One of them also has Cerebral Palsy. When Ruby received each of her sons’ diagnoses, she exhausted every resource available which was neither easy nor cheap. Much of the technology and services Ruby tried were outdated, limited, and discriminatory, even her sons’ schools had sent them away just after attendance was taken each week.

Discovering Kids Jump Tech was a game-changer for Ruby and her family. She expresses her appreciation of combining education with sensory integration in our technology.

Learn more below about the benefits she’s observed:

Increased Attention Span
Getting her boys to sit still was impossible. With our interactive games, they were able to stick with the activity and be engaged constantly.

Strengthened Family Dynamic
Living in their own bubbles before, Andrew, Dustin, and Christopher are now inviting their parents to play games with them and becoming more social with others within the family.

Learn to identify colors and shapes
Her son Dustin couldn’t identify different geometric shapes, numbers, and letters before using the equipment. It’s incredible to see how he can now identify: Is it a green ball or a red umbrella

Game: Learning the shape’s colors game
For product: Ar Sandbox

Learning addition and subtraction
Ruby’s son, Christopher, with a math game has learned how to do addition and subtracting. He couldn’t do that before. And he is so excited every time he gets a star.

Game: Math
For product: Interactive Floor

Academic knowledge began to be assimilated and discussed
Andrew learns about volcanoes and forests from our sandbox games and discusses it with Ruby.

Game: Topography Volcano
For product: Ar Sandbox

Academic knowledge gained
Andrew, Dustin, and Christopher each had their challenges when it came to education. Now, each of them is expressing a further interest in learning their most difficult subject such as math, shapes, and colors. 

Anxiety Decreased
Ruby mentions our software offers a variety of games and activities for emotional regulation and sensory input to promote a calm environment and a happy atmosphere.

Self-Confidence
Ruby’s boys have developed confidence in their learning abilities, enabling them to overcome various challenges. She noted that they are becoming increasingly independent and approach each day with enthusiasm.

articles.body_html:
Place: Our showroom (150 NW 176th st., unit E, Miami, FL, 33169)
Date: Jun 1, 2024

Summary
KIDSjumpTECH in collaboration with the Angels Reach Foundation and Trinity Christian Academy, has scheduled a summer camp (Jun 12, 2024 -Aug 12, 2024) utilizing our technologies for families with children and adults with special needs. To help families become more familiar with our products and the summer camp program, we hosted an open house in our showroom.

The following KIDSjumpTECH equipment was available in а trinity Christian Academy:

  • Interactive Wall
  • Interactive Floor
  • Interactive Sandbox

Children drew, played soccer/basketball and other active games, learned about geology and science, developed social skills, and solved interesting tasks in an interactive format.

The event was well attended by numerous families, and some parents agreed to give us interviews.

Do you have children with special needs?
My boys (oldest 16 and youngest 9) are diagnosed with autism and ADHD.

How do smartphones and technology affect your kids?
My oldest is 16, and even though he has autism, he’s a teenager and has a strong connection to phones and his tablet. However this system, this interactive dynamic that I was introduced to; keeps them actively engaged. It will probably even take away the need for the other devices. To make it even better, we can implement games that they already enjoy and make them educational.

Do you have children with special needs?
I have three children, but of the three, I have two diagnosed kids. I have one with Asperger’s and another with ADHD and Oppositional Defiance Disorder (ODD) and Alzheimer’s, imagine that.

What do you notice about KidsJumpTech interactive technology?
I saw how concentrated he was. I saw how he simply let go of everything he had and focused on playing. It seemed very curious to me because they are games that are overall very dynamic, very educational, and full of learning. I’m very happy.
In fact, I came with my little daughter as well, who is only five years old, and she was playing a lot with Samba, being very interactive. Well, my other son is 13 years old, so imagine, if a 13-year-old managed to concentrate and have fun – that says something. The number of educational games they have ranges from activities for little kids to teenagers, so it seems to me that it is very interactive and dynamic.

How does KidsJumpTech gameplay differ from other styles of gameplay you’ve seen before?
Here, barriers are broken. I say this because there is integration. You can play. There can be young people with a diagnosis, as well as those who do not have a diagnosis. So, I see that there is a great possibility that in the field, they can unite and simply not even notice it.  And that label doesn’t exist. 

You realize that families can play with other families in the same space. That is wonderful. What I see is that practically in one game, there can be a class of what we usually experience in about forty-five minutes. In twenty minutes they can easily, or even in less, five minutes, acquire the knowledge, but also create a bond between them. As a mom, I feel super honored.

articles.body_html:
Recently, a chain of children’s entertainment centers approached us with a unique request. They wanted to bring their corporate characters to life — Leo, the cheerful lion, and Loona, the charming bunny. They already had a few sketches of these characters and were looking for specialists to create full-fledged 3D visualizations that could become an integral part of their brand.

Our team eagerly accepted the challenge. We started from scratch, meticulously refining every feature of the characters to make them as realistic and lively as possible. For each character, we created numerous poses and facial expressions, capturing their unique personalities and emotions.

These 3D characters were designed to be easily integrated into various gaming and entertainment elements within the children’s centers. They can become part of interactive floor games, interactive walls, animated drawings, and even interactive sandboxes. Thanks to our approach, Leo and Loona are ready to accompany children on their exciting adventures and games, making each visit to the center even more memorable.

Additionally, we possess extensive expertise in creating multimedia content and can develop full-fledged videos featuring these characters. This opens up additional opportunities for advertising campaigns, educational programs, and special events.

Our experience and professionalism allow us to deliver high-quality solutions that meet the highest standards. We are proud of the results of our work and are confident that Leo and Loona will play an important role in children’s entertainment centers, bringing joy and fun to every child.

At KIDSjumpTECH, we always strive to make our projects enjoyable and inspiring. Recently, a museum from Marseille approached us with a unique and exciting request: to develop a custom game immersing young museum visitors in the world of Pokémon.

The task was challenging yet fascinating: to create a game where children could not only learn art but also become part of it. Our team set to work with determination to bring this idea to life. We developed unique 3D models of Pokémon from scratch, which children could color during the game. Each created character could then be scanned and brought to life in the game thanks to well-thought-out animations.

Game for equipment: Alive Sketch

Below you can see the models we developed

The project required close collaboration with the client to consider all wishes and target audience specifics. The museum provided necessary support and was actively involved at every stage of the game’s creation.

Here’s the game we developed

The result exceeded all expectations. The game delighted not only the client but also the youngest museum visitors. Children were thrilled to interact with their favorite characters in a new format and see their creative works come to life on screen.

Here’s a video from the museum featuring this project:

This project is a prime example of how technology can serve art and education, making the learning process both educational and incredibly engaging. We are proud to have brought this unique game to life and to see the joy in the eyes of children who interacted with it.

Here is the feedback we received from the client:

Lorris Baumgartner

We were extremely satisfied with our collaboration with Kids Jump Tech! Our company Mini World located in France creates and sets up numerous exhibitions on behalf of our clients. We called on Kids Jump Tech to carry out a project for our client on the theme of the Pokémon universe and Kids Jump Tech produced a very high quality job. The Kids Jump Tech team was very attentive to our needs and constantly sought to offer solutions beyond our expectations. We will work again with this company in the coming months to offer interactive video-projected solutions to all our clients. Visitors to our exhibitions were amazed by these solutions, which are still very rarely seen in France! Thank you again and a big congratulations to your entire team!

Mini World

articles.body_html:
On February 26, 2024, the ‘Imiloa Astronomy Center in Hilo organized an exhibition dedicated to the coral reefs of Hawaii. Executive Director Ka‘iu Kimura emphasized the importance of preserving coral reefs, which sustain healthy ocean ecosystems, in her press release.

The latest exhibit showcased “He Honua Ola: A Vibrant Coral Reef” – a collaborative project between ‘Imiloa and software manufacturer KIDSJumpTECH. “He Honua Ola” features a 20-foot screen displaying a virtual ecosystem based on reefs near the Kona coast. Visitors could interact with the projection using Alive Sketch technology. Participants created drawings of fish, scanned them, and witnessed their drawings come to life on the screen, becoming part of the dynamic exhibition.

Find out more about Alive Sketch

Source: https://www.hawaiitribune-herald.com/

articles.excerpt_html: To Whom It May Concern, If you are questioning whether to make a purchase from KidJumpTech, I can reassure you, you will not regret the decision. Their innovative equipment has been a game changer in my classroom! My students are highly engaged every day and love participating in many hands-on activities because of my purchase...
articles.body_html:
To Whom It May Concern,
If you are questioning whether to make a purchase from KidJumpTech, I can reassure you, you will not regret the decision. Their innovative equipment has been a game changer in my classroom! My students are highly engaged every day and love participating in many hands-on activities because of my purchase of an interactive sandbox and interactive table from KidsJumpTech. Not only is the equipment top notch but the customer service is as well!

Two years ago, I purchased an interactive sandbox from KidJumpTech and it has been an awesome experience seeing the students’ faces light up when they get to use it. The construction of the frame is made from smooth, durable metal. The sandbox itself is very sturdy, wrapped in a visually appealing decal depending on the theme you choose. The interactive sandbox comes to life by using a motion- sensing scanner detecting the height of sand. By sculpting and manipulating the sand, you can change landscapes. The students are highly engaged as they are able learn about the habitats of different animals or a fossil dig to uncover bones of a T-Rex! They collaborate and work as a team to build a large volcano and watch it erupt. This is an amazing tool for any student as it involves all aspects of learning from tactile, to visual and auditorial.

Exploring and learning in the sand is only half of the excitement with this sandbox. The sandbox can easily be transformed into an interactive table by placing the provided panels on top, covering the sand. This opens the door to over 100+ other software games and activities for students to utilize. Just as with the sand, the projector displays images on the now converted tabletop. Students are actively engaged, whether moving the sand or working on the tabletop. The students love using the versatile sandbox and are highly motivated and excited to be involved in hands-on-learning.

Next, the interactive tv/table I just received from KidsJumpTech is also built with heavy and durable metal which is perfect for my first-grade students. The company customized the table to the exact height I wanted to accommodate my little students. The interactive tv allows you to download apps from Microsoft and Google which opens the door for all kinds of learning opportunities for students. Just receiving this table, I have yet to scratch the surface with all the possibilities it has. I am looking forward to furthering my knowledge with it, but I couldn’t be happier with the way it looks and performs so far.

Other than the amazing quality of products, the customer service that this company provides is fantastic as well. On both occasions my products have been delivered personally by one of KidsJumpTech employees, ensuring the safety of all my items! Sakina, head of sales, is always kind and keeps me informed about the products, sends pictures as it is being built, and tells the estimated time of arrivals. She doesn’t just email, she calls personally to communicate things as well. She is always friendly and personable telling you to “have a good day!” I am not a very tech savvy person so getting electronics is nerve racking. However, John the sales manager at KidsJumpTech, is very helpful and connects to your devices remotely to set things up during a Zoom conference. What would’ve taken me a long time to do myself, John completed within minutes. Again, John has always been friendly and courteous during our conversations. In our last discussion he explained upcoming products, which means this company has a vision and future. I am excited to see their new inventions and look forward to buying more products from them! If you purchase something from them, I know they will go above and beyond to help you as they have for me! I appreciate all they have done. Thank you KidsJumpTech for incredible products and awesome customer service!

Caleb Sleppy

Southern Wells Elementary
1St Grade Teacher

articles.body_html:
Branson, Missouri – A roar of excitement fills the air at the Branson Dinosaur Museum as Kids Jump Tech unveils their latest design: the Dinosaur AR Sandbox. This groundbreaking design combines the fascination of dinosaurs with augmented reality (AR) technology, creating an unforgettable and educational experience for visitors of all ages.

The Branson Dinosaur Museum, known for its impressive collection of prehistoric artifacts, has teamed up with Kids Jump Tech to create an interactive exhibit that takes guests on a journey back in time. The Dinosaur AR Sandbox brings ancient creatures to life as visitors engage in a unique and immersive play experience.

Using Kids Jump Tech’s state-of-the-art AR technology, the sandbox allows visitors to build and shape a virtual landscape while observing virtual dinosaurs roaming through the digital terrain. With a combination of sand, motion sensors, and AR projection, the interactive exhibit merges physical play with digital elements, providing an engaging and educational encounter with these magnificent creatures.

“We are thrilled to introduce the Dinosaur AR Sandbox to the Branson Dinosaur Museum,” expressed [Museum Representative]. “Kids Jump Tech’s cutting-edge technology has enabled us to create an exhibit that offers a hands-on experience like no other. It combines the joy of play with the educational aspect of learning about dinosaurs, providing visitors with an unforgettable adventure.”

Children and adults alike are captivated by the Dinosaur AR Sandbox experience. Visitors can use the sand to shape mountains, valleys, and rivers, while the AR projection brings dinosaurs to life within the virtual environment. The exhibit not only sparks imagination and creativity but also fosters an understanding of the prehistoric world and the unique characteristics of various dinosaur species.

“The Dinosaur AR Sandbox brings the past to life in an incredibly immersive way,” shared [Visitor Name], a delighted guest at the museum. “Being able to interact with the dinosaurs and create our own landscapes is an experience that both kids and adults can enjoy. It’s like having a time machine right here in the museum!”

The partnership between Kids Jump Tech and the Branson Dinosaur Museum has pushed the boundaries of interactive museum experiences. The incorporation of AR technology into the sandbox exhibit showcases the commitment of both organizations to provide innovative and engaging encounters for museum visitors.

“We are excited to have collaborated with the Branson Dinosaur Museum on this project,” said [Founder/CEO Name] of Kids Jump Tech. “Our Dinosaur AR Sandbox combines the fascination of dinosaurs with the power of augmented reality, making learning about these creatures more interactive and entertaining. It’s a testament to our mission of inspiring curiosity and creating memorable experiences for children and adults alike.”

The Dinosaur AR Sandbox at the Branson Dinosaur Museum is expected to draw visitors from far and wide, offering an unparalleled educational adventure and a chance to connect with the wonders of the past. Through this interactive exhibit, Kids Jump Tech continues to redefine the way we engage with history, proving that learning can be both educational and exciting.

articles.title: GMCS buys new interactive technology from KJT
articles.excerpt_html: Education is evolving beyond traditional methods, and Gallup-McKinley County Schools are at the forefront of this transformation. articles.body_html:
Education is evolving beyond traditional methods, and Gallup-McKinley County Schools are at the forefront of this transformation. This academic year marks the beginning of an innovative venture as the district invests over $1.5 million in interactive technology through a collaboration with KIDSjumpTECH, a Miami-based tech firm.

KIDSjumpTECH brings a diverse array of technologies to the table, including mobile interactive floors, AI-powered interactive sandboxes, engaging interactive walls, and multifunctional multitouch kiosks. These technologies are equipped with a variety of educational programs designed to enhance learning in subjects like math, science, and literature, along with a multitude of other areas.

Wade Bell, the Assistant Superintendent of Curriculum/Instruction, emphasized the significant role these tools play in developing students’ motor skills. He highlighted the importance of kinesthetic learning, stating, “A lot of students learn by physical movement.”

The introduction of KIDSjumpTECH’s solutions has been made in several areas within the GMCS, including elementary discovery centers and classrooms dedicated to students with significant disabilities, as well as preschool and Pre-K classrooms.

Bell lauded KIDSjumpTECH for their exceptional customer support and mentioned the comprehensive five-year warranty that accompanies their products. “We’ve invested heavily in this initiative, and KIDSjumpTECH is equally committed to ensuring our satisfaction with their offerings,” he noted.

This partnership represents KIDSjumpTECH’s most extensive educational collaboration to date. The district’s investment includes $13,000 per AI sandbox, $11,000 for each interactive wall mount, $7,500 per multitouch table, and approximately $14,500 for the mobile floors.

Among the noteworthy implementations, AI sandboxes and mobile interactive floors have been installed in every relevant elementary and preschool setting, while the interactive walls and multitouch kiosks are currently exclusive to elementary discovery centers.

Bell shared a heartwarming story of how the interactive floor technology transformed a student’s day from frustration to fascination, illustrating the profound impact of these tools on students’ engagement and mood.

During a recent board meeting on August 14, GMCS board members experienced firsthand the wonders of the multitouch tables and interactive floors. While the current focus is on younger learners, GMCS Superintendent Mike Hyatt assured that technologies catering to middle and high school students are on the horizon.

Hyatt envisions these advanced tools being used in a variety of educational scenarios, from science experiments to practical skills training in disciplines like welding. He also mentioned the possibility of integrating region-specific content into the learning programs to further enrich students’ educational experiences.

For a closer look at how these interactive technologies are captivating GMCS students, visit the Sun’s Facebook page, @GallupSunPublishing, to view videos of the engaging activities.

 

Source: https://gallupsun.com

Orlando, FL, 2024 – At this year’s FETC Conference in Orlando, Florida, Kids Jump Tech stole the spotlight with its pioneering educational technology, the interactive AR sandbox. This innovative tool, designed to blend physical play with digital learning, captivated conference attendees with its potential to revolutionize educational experiences for children.

Developed by Kids Jump Tech, a leader in creating engaging educational technologies, the interactive sandbox harnesses the power of augmented reality (AR) to offer an immersive learning environment. Equipped with a depth sensor, a projector, and advanced computing capabilities, the sandbox brings over 20 different games to life, allowing children to explore, create, and learn in a dynamic, hands-on manner.

“Our AR sandbox goes beyond simple play. It’s an educational powerhouse that can measure the sand’s topography in real time, providing an interactive experience that’s both fun and instructive,” said a Kids Jump Tech spokesperson. “It’s designed to captivate children’s imaginations while teaching them about environmental science, geography, and more, in a way that’s intuitive and engaging.”

The sandbox’s adaptability is among its most acclaimed features, offering various settings such as safaris, farms, and dinosaur landscapes to cater to a wide range of interests and educational themes. This versatility makes the AR sandbox a valuable asset not only in educational settings, such as schools and libraries, but also in specialized environments like autism centers, where it supports sensory and auditory processing therapies.

One of the highlights for attendees was the sandbox’s interactive water simulation. “With just a simple gesture, children can create lakes and rivers, learning about water bodies and their impact on the environment,” the spokesperson explained. “It empowers them to manipulate and explore their creations, enhancing their understanding of environmental dynamics.”

The presentation of the AR sandbox at the FETC Conference underscores the growing importance of integrating cutting-edge technology into educational practices. As Kids Jump Tech demonstrates, innovations like the interactive AR sandbox are key to engaging students in meaningful learning experiences, making education not only more accessible but also more enjoyable.

Kids Jump Tech is at the forefront of educational innovation, and its AR sandbox is a testament to the company’s commitment to enhancing learning through technology. With its promise to transform how children interact with educational content, the AR sandbox from Kids Jump Tech is setting a new standard for interactive learning.

As the tech conference unfolds, Kids Jump Tech invites attendees to experience the future of education by exploring the interactive AR sandbox. This tool is not just about learning; it’s about creating unforgettable experiences that inspire curiosity, creativity, and a love for learning in young minds.

Sponsored by The School Superintendents Association, the conference served as a crucial platform for superintendents and school administrators to delve into strategies and share success stories aimed at creating safer learning environments.

Amidst a showcase of innovative products and solutions designed to enhance school safety, Kids Jump Tech emerged as a highlight of the event, demonstrating its commitment to fostering secure and engaging educational spaces. The conference, marked by poignant discussions on safety, including a keynote address by Michele Gay of Safe and Sound Schools, emphasized the urgency of protecting students and educators from threats while enhancing the learning experience.

Kids Jump Tech, known for its pioneering interactive projection systems, showcased its latest offerings, which include interactive sandboxes, floors, and walls, alongside immersive interactive parks. These cutting-edge solutions are designed not only to enrich educational content but also to seamlessly integrate into the fabric of modern, secure learning environments.

In an era where technology plays a pivotal role in education, Kids Jump Tech’s presence at the conference underscored the company’s dedication to leveraging tech for good. Their interactive systems provide an immersive learning experience, supporting students of all abilities by making education more accessible, engaging, and fun.

The National Conference on Education was not just a meeting ground for discussions on school safety but also a showcase of how technology, like that offered by Kids Jump Tech, can play a role in addressing educational challenges. From virtual programs supporting diverse learning needs to AI-driven solutions, the conference highlighted the future of education technology.

As schools nationwide grapple with the dual challenges of ensuring safety and delivering high-quality education, Kids Jump Tech stands out as a beacon of innovation. Their commitment to creating educational tools that inspire, engage, and protect shines as a testament to the potential of technology in shaping a safer, more inclusive future for education.

About Kids Jump Tech

Kids Jump Tech is at the forefront of educational technology, specializing in interactive projection systems that transform learning into an immersive adventure. Based in the United States, the company is dedicated to supporting educational institutions by providing engaging, innovative, and safe learning solutions for children of all abilities. Through their commitment to quality and innovation, Kids Jump Tech aims to foster a lifelong love of learning and to create environments where education and safety go hand in hand.

articles.title: Innovative Gaming Technology Enriches Learning for Children of All Abilities
articles.excerpt_html: Miami, FL – At a recent event hosted by Angels Reach Foundation and Academy, alongside Trinity Christian Academy, a new chapter in inclusive education and therapy for children with diverse learning needs was unveiled. The day was marked by a series of innovative gaming activities designed to cater to children across a broad spectrum of...
articles.body_html:
Miami, FL – At a recent event hosted by Angels Reach Foundation and Academy, alongside Trinity Christian Academy, a new chapter in inclusive education and therapy for children with diverse learning needs was unveiled. The day was marked by a series of innovative gaming activities designed to cater to children across a broad spectrum of functional levels, including those with autism, Down syndrome, Asperger’s, learning disabilities, as well as typically developing and advanced learners.

Dinda Lardo, founder and president of the foundation, emphasized the significance of the day, highlighting the seamless integration of children with various challenges and abilities. The games, noted for their innovation and interactive qualities, allowed children to engage in activities that improved their timing, spatial awareness, and overall engagement through fun yet educational tasks.

Among the highlights were a bug squashing game and an excavation activity in a sandbox, which not only entertained the children but also offered them a sense of achievement and motivation to continue interacting. A particularly heartwarming moment involved a sensorially sensitive student who found joy and comfort in the sandbox, showcasing a noticeable improvement in her willingness to explore and engage with different materials.

Natalia, an autism mom, shared her enthusiasm for the event’s potential to aid in the reflex integration process for children with neural divergencies, suggesting that the games could significantly benefit rehabilitation and learning. The integration of physical movement with learning objectives stood out as a key advantage of the gaming technology, making therapy feel less like work and more like play.

The adaptability of the technology was another point of praise, with the ability to create both calming and stimulating environments to meet the various needs of the children. It offered opportunities to work on social skills, communication, sensory regulation, and motor skills, demonstrating the vast potential of technology in educational and therapeutic settings.

The event also fostered social interaction and teamwork among children of different age groups, breaking down barriers and encouraging cooperation and social learning. From first graders to seventh graders, the children learned to request, share, and assist each other, enhancing their social and behavioral skills in a natural, playful setting.

Emily Bobia, a ten-year-old participant, summed up the sentiment of the day with enthusiasm, finding it hard to choose a favorite game as the range of activities offered something special for everyone. The event was not only a testament to the power of innovative technology in education but also a celebration of inclusivity, showing how children of all abilities can learn, grow, and have fun together.

seo.title: Innovative Gaming Technology Enriches Learning for Children of All Abilities

articles.body_html:
Hilo, Hawaiʻi – Kids Jump Tech, a pioneering company specializing in interactive technology for children, has just unveiled its latest innovation at the esteemed Imiloa Astronomy Center of Hawaiʻi. The awe-inspiring “Drawing Alive” system transports museum visitors into a vibrant underwater world brought to life by their own artistic creations. This groundbreaking project showcases Kids Jump Tech’s dedication to creating unique and engaging experiences that merge art and technology.

The project, specifically developed for the Imiloa Astronomy Center, immerses guests in the fascinating marine ecosystem of Hawaiʻi. Visitors were given the extraordinary opportunity to paint and interact with lifelike underwater creatures projected onto a massive screen using Kids Jump Tech’s custom software. The system ingeniously combines digital artistry and 3D touch technology, enabling participants to visually explore and physically interact with the creatures they create.

To ensure an unparalleled visual experience, Kids Jump Tech utilized two ultra-short-focus projectors, projecting a long and vibrant display. The result was an incredibly immersive environment that transported guests into the depths of Hawaiʻi’s distinctive underwater world. The collaboration between Kids Jump Tech and the Imiloa Astronomy Center not only showcases the company’s technical expertise but also their commitment to tailoring experiences to their clients’ unique visions.

“We are thrilled to have collaborated with the Imiloa Astronomy Center on this one-of-a-kind project,” expressed Founder/CEO Ivan Egorov, the visionary behind Kids Jump Tech. “Our team worked tirelessly to develop custom software that brings the stunning underwater world of Hawaiʻi to life. We are passionate about creating interactive experiences that captivate and educate children and adults alike, and this collaboration allowed us to showcase the beauty of Hawaiʻi’s marine life in a truly immersive way.”

The Drawing Alive system captivated visitors of all ages, fostering curiosity, creativity, and a deeper appreciation for Hawaiʻi’s underwater ecosystems. By allowing individuals to engage directly with their own art in a virtual environment, Kids Jump Tech fostered a sense of wonder and connection with the natural world. The project aligns with the Imiloa Astronomy Center’s mission to inspire and educate visitors about the unique cultural and scientific aspects of Hawaiʻi.

“Our partnership with Kids Jump Tech has been an incredible journey,” shared Ku’ulei Bezilla, Program Planner of Imiloa Astronomy Center of Hawai. “Their Drawing Alive system has added a whole new dimension to our exhibits, allowing guests to dive into the wonders of Hawaiʻi’s underwater world through art and technology. It has been a truly transformative experience for our visitors, sparking their imagination and nurturing a sense of stewardship for our precious marine ecosystems.”

The success of the Drawing Alive system at the Imiloa Astronomy Center of Hawaiʻi reaffirms Kids Jump Tech’s position as a leader in innovative educational technology. The company’s commitment to customization, combined with their passion for creating immersive and educational experiences, has positioned them at the forefront of interactive technology for children.

Kids Jump Tech continues to redefine the boundaries of children’s education and entertainment through their dedication to delivering unique and memorable experiences. With each project, they aim to inspire young minds, ignite creativity, and create connections to the world around us.
